testResults.name: mid-touch-fill-model
testResults.result: 34 new tests covering the documented adverse midpoint rule: fills only at exact on-tick midpoints when the far touch is marketable through the limit, market and stop orders take the touch or trade print, tick gate, maximum-spread gate, adverse-touch gate, displayed-size capping, stop arming, YAML configuration loading, and replay determinism

testResults.name: options-multi-leg-matching
testResults.result: 24 new tests covering atomic all-leg fillability on a single constituent quote update, staggered quotes completing atomically later or never, a non-fillable leg blocking the whole group, natural-touch and mid combination net debit or credit gates against the exact MultiLegOrderGroup net rule, displayed-size pools, ratio legs, IOC expiry, cancellation, MultiLegOMS integration with per-venue fill ids, latency and injected clock, and SimVenue drop-in determinism replay

testResults.name: determinism-golden-preserved
testResults.result: 9 golden determinism tests pass; no engine-path files were modified

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff lint, format check, ty type check, and the complete pytest suite passed with 978 tests after wave integration

limitations: The engine requires a MidTouch instance because group matching needs the mid_execution primitive, and emits only Fill events with group lifecycle reports remaining in the OMS; option fills carry per-contract notional prices per the portfolio settlement convention
